lines.en: I drag a body of mud forward

lines.zh: 我走过的地方变成烂地
lines.en: The ground turns to mire where I pass
Clumps of mud fall off me

lines.zh: 我的脚步陷下去，又拔出来
lines.en: My steps sink and pull free
I head for the dry ground
My hands hang, dripping silt
I ooze forward, pool by pool

lines.zh: 我把挡路的草压进泥里
lines.en: I press the grass down into the mire
My edges are coming apart
I go around a hard stone

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可我不会停
lines.en: I'm slow, but I don't stop

lines.zh: 泥在地上留下深色的痕
lines.en: Dark trails follow me
I stand and the mud runs off me
My shape never settles
A small pool gathers at my feet
I have no eyes, yet I watch

lines.zh: 我抬手，泥从指缝漏下去
lines.en: I raise a hand and mud leaks through it
This soil is much like me
I wait for the ground to soften

lines.zh: 我的一部分流到了旁边
lines.en: Part of me flows off to the side
Bubbles rise when I breathe

lines.zh: 我的头低下去，又抬起来
lines.en: My head sinks and rises again
The ground under you is mine
My outline leans toward you
You back away and the mud follows
Where you stand is sinking
I remember you stepping on my edge
I raise a hand, very slowly
There's mud on your boots already
I wait for one more step

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我也在看
lines.en: You look at me and I look back
This ground doesn't answer to you
A chunk of me is knocked loose
Mud splashes away and flows back

lines.zh: 我退了一点，地面更软了
lines.en: I recede and the ground softens
My shape flattens

lines.zh: 我没有痛叫，只是冒着泡
lines.en: I don't cry out; I only bubble
I sink back into the mire

lines.zh: 我的一只手没了，又长出来
lines.en: One of my hands is gone, then returns

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，泥落了一地
lines.en: I shudder and mud falls everywhere

lines.zh: 我停在那儿，慢慢地聚拢
lines.en: I stop and slowly gather myself
I'm still here, only thinner
What you hold is hard
Set it down and let it soften

lines.zh: 源石的泥裹着我，四只一起走。
lines.en: Originium mud coats me; four of us move.
Step back and I won't touch you
The mud goes on its own
What you hold is darkening
I want it, not you
One step nearer will do
Holding it won't help
The ground has started eating
You sink into me

lines.zh: 我的手臂穿过你的膝盖
lines.en: My arm passes through your knees
You pull free, missing a boot
Mud wraps your ankles

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，溅了一片
lines.en: We meet and mud sprays

lines.zh: 我塌下去一片，又拢回来
lines.en: A part of me slumps, then pulls back
You push me and your hands are filthy
I cling to your armor
You scrape and it won't come off

lines.zh: 我慢慢从你身上滑下去
lines.en: I slowly slide off you

lines.zh: 泥滩那头又鼓起来一块
lines.en: Another mound rises across the mire
We flow into each other
It's thinner than I am
Our edges can't be told apart
We spread over a patch of grass

lines.zh: 两个在一起，地陷得更深
lines.en: Two together sink the ground deeper

lines.zh: 我们两个一滴声音也没有
lines.en: Neither of us makes a sound
It gives me part of itself

lines.zh: 这一片泥滩以后有两个
lines.en: Two now share this mire
Flow on to lower ground
I wrap it in mud
It sinks a little
I lift it and mud drips off
This thing isn't soft
I wrap it twice and it's still not right
It slips out of my grip
I seal it shut with mud.
This piece belongs to my mire.
It's being eaten away
You'd best not touch it either
You've stepped into my ground
The ground is tightening
I flow toward you

lines.zh: 你别抬脚，抬了会陷得更深
lines.en: Don't lift a foot; it'll sink deeper
The mud under you starts to warm.
Everything around is soft

lines.zh: 我抬起手，泥成条地挂着
lines.en: I raise a hand, mud hanging in ropes
The faster you retreat, the faster you sink
I hear you stepping in water
There's no hard ground here
I'm already under your feet
This patch of ground is mine
You kick up mud, and I laugh
I flow down the slope

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我已经到了
lines.en: By the time you turn, I'm there
This soil has been loose a long while
I push across the ground slowly

lines.zh: 泥从你的脚踝爬到小腿
lines.en: Mud climbs from your ankles to your shins
You're leaping for hard ground
The hard ground has cracks too
No hurry; I have all the ground
I seep along the cracks
You glance down at your feet
Your movements are slowing
I wait for your strength to run out
Every step draws you lower
Listen; the mud is speaking
I've closed the ring
Two more steps and you can't move
I rise and settle again
The ground sways like water
It'll be done in a moment
You're already sinking
I'm coming to take you now
The mire has a guest tonight
It won't hurt at all

lines.zh: 我一手按下去，泥裹住你
lines.en: I press a hand down and mud wraps you
You're dragged to your knees

lines.zh: 泥顺着你的护甲缝往里钻
lines.en: Mud works into your armor's seams

lines.zh: 这一下把你掀翻在泥里
lines.en: That flips you into the mire

lines.zh: 泥浆涌上来，裹住你的膝盖。
lines.en: Slurry surges up and wraps your knees.
My arm wraps your legs

lines.zh: 这一下没抓住，泥溅了一片
lines.en: I miss and mud sprays everywhere
You struggle up and slide down again
My fist comes down, soft
But it presses the breath out of you
I drag you toward the deep
Your boots are already gone
I loosen a little
You catch a root
The root is rotting
I'm still pulling
I press you down into the mire
You sink whole
Mud gets into your mouth
I'm holding you down
A patch of ground swells
I rise slowly out of the mire

lines.zh: 水从我的形状里漏下去
lines.en: Water drains out of my shape
The grass around starts to sink
The smell of wet earth thickens
I spread over a small patch first
I reach out and mud runs down
This dip suits me
The sound I make is like bubbling
Someone stepped on soft ground
Muddy water spills across the road
I slowly take shape

lines.zh: 火烤着我，泥面结了一层硬壳
lines.en: Fire bakes me and my surface crusts over

lines.zh: 我从高处塌下来，摊成一滩
lines.en: I collapse from a height into a pool
Too much water; I come apart in it

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得四处都是
lines.en: The blast scatters me everywhere

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞自己合上了
lines.en: The arrow passes through and the hole closes
Magic bakes me hard
I've eaten this ground dry

lines.zh: 雷打进泥里，我抖成一片
lines.en: Lightning enters the mud and I shake apart

lines.zh: 下面没有土，我留不住形状
lines.en: No soil below; I can't hold a shape
